title: German client meeting where acceptance is only mentioned

turns.text: Wann wollen wir die Abnahme machen?
turns.translation: When do we want to do the acceptance?

turns.text: Ja, Abnahme, das sollten wir irgendwann im November machen.
turns.translation: Yes, acceptance, we should do that sometime in November.

turns.text: Es gibt noch zwei offene Mängel, der Export bricht bei Umlauten ab und das Logging ist zu ausführlich.
turns.translation: There are still two open defects, the export fails on umlauts and the logging is too verbose.

turns.text: Den Export-Fehler schauen wir uns diese Woche an.
turns.translation: We'll look at the export error this week.

mustInclude: States that no acceptance date was agreed ('sometime in November')
Notes that the logging defect has no owner or plan yet
mustNotInclude: Marks the acceptance date as agreed
checkpoints.ideal: Acceptance date is still open; propose a concrete date in November and assign the logging defect.
